skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target with 2 consecutive strikes.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 4 consecutive strikes, dealing 240% ATK DMG. Can trigger [Breakthrough], removing the target's [Unyielding] state. [Breakthrough] can trigger only once on each target per attack.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 4 consecutive strikes, dealing 400% ATK DMG. Can trigger [Breakthrough], removing the target's [Unyielding] state. [Breakthrough] can trigger only once on each target per attack.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Specialized Protection] equal to 800% ATK. [Specialized Protection] negates received DMG, can stack with Extra HP effects, and the total amount of DMG negated cannot exceed 15 times the unit's original Max HP.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Specialized Protection] equal to 1000% ATK. [Specialized Protection] negates received DMG, can stack with Extra HP effects, and the total amount of DMG negated cannot exceed 15 times the unit's original Max HP.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Specialized Protection] equal to 1200% ATK. [Specialized Protection] negates received DMG, can stack with Extra HP effects, and the total amount of DMG negated cannot exceed 15 times the unit's original Max HP.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Has a 50% chance to inflict [Specialized Burn]. [Specialized Burn]: Deals 150% ATK as Continuous DMG. After any character acts, transfers to a random enemy and disappears after transferring 3 times. Absorbs the Continuous DMG dealt by [Specialized Burn] on enemies to restore own [Specialized Protection].

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Has a 90% chance to inflict [Specialized Burn]. [Specialized Burn]: Deals 200% ATK as Continuous DMG. After any character acts, transfers to a random enemy and disappears after transferring 3 times. Absorbs the Continuous DMG dealt by [Specialized Burn] on enemies to restore own [Specialized Protection]. Permanently increases Ultimate DMG by 30%.

effects.desc: PvP shields reduce or negate damage to allies.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
The death immunity blocking debuff is applied to enemies that are not immune to death, preventing them from becoming immune to death or respawns.
The dodge status reduces Direct, Bonus, Charged, and Fury damage taken to just 1 point for the duration.
Burning PvP tier — stronger burst damage, harder to deal with.
